architectureDecisions: D1: Select NODE_HTTP_SQLITE_LOCAL_V1: trusted local loopback HTTP service, Node 24.20.0/Linux x64 and an owned file-backed SQLite fixture. A finite externally pinned previous-client request/assertion manifest plus independent row assertions verifies one explicit forward migration and a fresh process restart; no inferred migration or generic OpenAPI compatibility claim.

D2: Implement createApiStateVerifier as the existing Product QA criterionVerifier injection. Resolve an external protected profile by snapshotRef/verifierPolicyRef, validate all input digests before effects and emit PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE plus content-addressed evidenceRefs. Product QA observes runtime identity, aggregates criteria and owns QualityAcceptance publication unchanged.

D3 (resolved): The worker implements the preview-snapshot and protected-evaluator adapters as plan-owned local shims with the exact interfaces declared in S1: a shim owns the candidate checkout, dataset copy, service handles and restart, migrates and restarts the same owned database without reseeding between releases, and cleans up only handles/paths with a matching ownership token. If BB-131/127 reach DONE before Worker starts, the worker rebinds to their delivered contracts instead; otherwise the plan-owned shims stand. No design decision remains open.

D4: Do not adopt Schemathesis/Testcontainers. Inspected pinned source/tests support optional future adapters; Node avoids Python/container prerequisites. No external runtime or comparative cost/value claim.
D5: Expose a callable factory via Product QA injection; no deliver manifest/CLI extension. Generic command checks remain usable. BB-071/074 own change/value and BB-129 owns handoff.
D6: Keep DRAFT; only fresh independent Jev SATISFIED grants readiness. Calibration establishes prototype feasibility, not product implementation, dependency delivery or value.

D7 — Map each fault to exact verdict/reason and effect boundary in testContract. Focused tests directly exercise the new factory and Product QA injection; generic QA tests cannot stand in for adapter evidence. Retain deterministic single-request/single-seed-row reproducers for observed compatibility failures and bounded setup diagnostics for inconclusive failures.
implementationSlices: S1 — After dependencies DONE/fresh READY, implement factory, config/digest/criterion validation and snapshot-to-protected-profile resolver. Bind preview and ownership before effects.

S2 — Verify baseline client/seed, execute candidate forward migration, old-client/new-feature assertions and restart a fresh process on the same store. Record old/new row/schema facts, enforce budgets and dispose only owned resources.

S3 — Emit content-addressed criterion observations/reproducers with all identities through existing Product QA. Test actual factory injection, every named negative and complete positive flow. Adapter cannot publish acceptance.

S4 — Run focused/QA/regression/docs checks, reconcile Living limits and provide bound Worker logs/source evidence. Rebind to BB-131/127 delivered contracts when DONE; otherwise keep the plan-owned shims from D3.

profileContract.resolver: resolvePinnedInput receives the QA verify request and returns immutable protected profileRef/hash, 40-hex Git candidateSha, checkout tree/config digest, previewReceiptRef/hash, environment/snapshot/release, evaluator/priorClient/businessAssertions/seed/migration refs+hashes, schema versions, criterionBindings and bounded commands. Hash actual bytes/canonical config. Criterion must belong to snapshot and every mandatory assertion must execute.
profileContract.previewShim: Proposed BB-131 shim: prepareOwned({candidateSha,seedRef,runId}) yields ownershipToken/storeRoot/service handle/receipt; startBaseline, migrateOnce, startCandidate, restartCandidate retain one store; observeStore returns row/schema facts; dispose accepts matching owned handles/token only. Commands are operator-declared with delivered child-env policy. Reject foreign realpaths/symlinks and remote endpoints before effects.
profileContract.protectedInputs: BB-127 pins external evaluator/client/business assertions outside candidate write scope; resolve by snapshot/policy. Candidate schema is diagnostic only. Rehash inputs/preview before effects, after migration/restart and before final evidence. Digest drift/missing identity fails closed. Trusted local commands are unsandboxed.
profileContract.fixture: Version 1 tasks(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,title/status required TEXT), seed id1/legacy/open. Migration adds priority INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, version 2. Assert old row/priority0; prior client creates id2; new client id3/priority2 updates title, rejects missing title and persists after restart. Seed digest binds inputs, not unchanged whole DB bytes.
profileContract.budgets: Default maximum 20 requests, 1000ms per HTTP request, 2000ms startup/readiness/migration/stop, 30000ms total run, 8192 bytes each response/diagnostic, 65536 bytes total evidence. Finite request sequence and fixed seed, no randomized generation. Abort/kill only owned children, close connections before reset, return INCONCLUSIVE on exhaustion with mandatory observations absent. Retain content-addressed sanitized evidence before cleanup.
profileContract.result: evidenceStore.put(envelope) returns immutable evidenceRef. API_STATE_CRITERION_EVIDENCE/version 1 binds criterionRef/verdict/reason, candidateSha/tree/config, snapshot/environment/release, preview/evaluator/priorClient/businessAssertions/seed/migration refs+hashes, schema versions, executedAssertionIds, phase/request/expected/actual or bounded raw diagnostics and cleanup. Store/cleanup failure prevents PASS. Return {verdict,evidenceRefs}; any caching requires all immutable identities and ownership, never prior-candidate results. For failure, retain the fixed-fixture single-request/single-row reduced reproducer specified in testContract, before owned cleanup; unrelated data is excluded. This is deterministic fixture reduction, not a generic minimization algorithm.

testContract.matrix: For each N1-N13 construct the actual factory, call verify with pinned external profile and use fresh owned SQLite/store/service fixtures. N1 deleted rows, N2 weakened candidate schema, N3 required-input addition, N4 response removal, N5 corruption, N6 restart reset => FAIL with observed first differing assertion. N7 digest drift/N8 missing/no-op mandatory assertions/N9 identity missing => INCONCLUSIVE before effects or acceptance; N10 migration/setup and N11 timeout/parse => INCONCLUSIVE with bounded diagnostics. N12 foreign resources survive; N13 unknown/skipped criteria cannot PASS. Positive control must execute every mandatory old/new/migration/restart assertion and PASS.
testContract.reproducer: For an observed HTTP/assertion mismatch retain exactly the failing finite request method/path/body, expected/actual status/body projection and the single seed row involved, plus candidate/config/evaluator/preview/store/schema identities. This deterministic reduction of the fixed fixture is the minimized reproducer; unrelated requests/rows are excluded. Setup failures retain minimal setup diagnostics, not an invented HTTP mismatch. Retain before cleanup, within profile budgets.
testContract.composition: Focused suite injects actual createApiStateVerifier into createProductQaExecutionStrategy with existing parseable snapshot/component/order fixtures and independent runtimeObserver. Demonstrate adapter FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE cannot publish QualityAcceptance, and release drift is rejected independently. Existing qa-authority run supplies generic regression coverage; focused owns new adapter-specific corruption cases.
